items.text: Per-category bookmark sort — each category header has A–Z and Rec chips (click again for manual drag order). The global sort setting was removed from Config → General; legacy sortMethod migrates across all pages on first dashboard load. :sort order / az / recent applies to the focused category and shows the category name in the command palette.

Sort chip active state — the active A–Z or Rec chip now shows a clear selected style immediately on click (is-active, aria-pressed, data-sort-mode on the control group). Manual drag order leaves both chips inactive. refreshAllCategorySortUi keeps headers in sync after incremental patches and settings refresh.

Category sort UX — sort chips stay at full opacity; buttons are keyboard-focusable with ←/→ navigation; category collapse ignores clicks on sort controls; virtual blocks (Other, unknown category) get header sort controls when missing after incremental patches.
Smart collection ℹ popover — the "why am I seeing this?" hint on smart collections uses a fixed-position body popover with a readable background (replacing the unreadable CSS tooltip).

Adaptive category title fitting — long category names shrink step by step down to the smallest General font size (xs) so they stay beside the sort chips on one row. If still too long at minimum size, the title may wrap to two lines with ellipsis; sort buttons always stay on the first row. A ResizeObserver on the dashboard grid and font-size changes re-run the fit after render, rename, and config sync (dashboard-category-title-fit.js).

Long-press category rename — press and hold a category header for ~500 ms (same timing as bookmark inline edit, not on A–Z / Rec) to rename inline on the dashboard. Double-click still works as a legacy shortcut. Cheat sheet, rotating tips, onboarding, Help, and the categories guided tour document the new gesture.

Category rename promo — the first inline rename shows a one-time Got it balloon beside the category header. Esc on the promo dismisses it and cancels rename. Reset via Reset all dashboard promos or :promo feature (EN/NL/DE/FR).

Feature tour spotlight — guided tour steps now highlight footer and header targets (search, commands, finders, pages overview) via a fixed body-level focus ring cutout, fixing backdrop-filter stacking issues in Safari and other browsers.

Pin & note row icons removed — pin/note toggles are gone from Config → General and bookmark rows no longer show pin/note badges. Pins still sort to the top of a category; notes stay searchable in fuzzy search and editable via :note, inline edit, and :pin / :unpin / G+P / :open pinned.
Favicon toggle + incremental render — bookmarkRenderFingerprint includes showIcons so toggling Show favicons (:favicons on/off) refreshes rows in place without a full grid rebuild.

Legacy sort migration — migrateLegacySortAllPages applies the old global sortMethod to every page's categories in one pass; transient _sortMigratedPageIds is stripped before settings persist (settings-sanitize.js).
Show favicons — Config → General → Bookmarks exposes the favicon visibility toggle with ℹ help and Playwright coverage (dashboard-show-icons.spec.js).

Playwright — dashboard-category-sort.spec.js (A–Z toggle, active chip state, drag-handle hide, full-opacity sort chips); favicon toggle spec; dashboard-category-sort.js, dashboard-category-title-fit.js, and dashboard-smart-why-popover.js.

Docs — CHANGELOG, What's new, README, MANUAL, config help (EN/NL/DE/FR), onboarding step, categories tour, and cheat sheet updated for category title fitting, sort active state, long-press rename, feature tour spotlight, and category rename promo.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v96 data version and 2026.06-dashboard-release-v75 dashboard release token; cat-sort-4, cat-title-fit-1, cat-longpress-1, cat-rename-promo-1, focus-ring-1, render-fp-icons-1, smart-why-popover-1, settings-sanitize-1.
